profile.headline: Web and Portal Developer
profile.summary:
Information technology professional with expertise in web development, visual design, information architecture, and User Experience (UX). Track record of creating high-impact designs designed to engage, attract, and promote corporate initiatives. Advancing design through the lifecycle: from initial explorations to final design deliverables, such as screen layouts, user interface elements, and prototypes. Capable of meeting new technical challenges and finding solutions to meet the needs of employees, customers, and clients.

Specialties: Government, Project Managing, E-Commerce, Search Engine Optimization, Customer Interface Design, Web Content Managing, and Technical Support.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Schatz provides contract services to commercial and government marketplaces. Make sure web pages are monitored. Verify and fix links, formatting (such as fonts, colors, spacing, etc.), and other issues. Prioritize and approach projects with flexibility and creativity. Implement W3C standards and Section 508 accessibility for website content. Follow usability, accessibility, and style-guide guidelines and best practices for web design. SEO implementation and optimization. Make sure the content displays correctly in all browsers and on all mobile devices. All new functionality or changes to the system are tested. Provide front-end interface development services.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Update Acquisition Google site and CORE Policy Handbook to ensure all web content meets Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards. Track site metrics such as speed, uptime, SEO effectiveness, and user engagement using tools like Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Designed wireframes for internal department pages. Diagnose and resolve issues such as broken links, downtime, and user access problems promptly to ensure reliable site operation.

positions.title: Portal Developer
positions.description:
Utilizes scripting languages such as HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, .NET, C#, JQuery for
SharePoint to create and modify page layouts and content on web pages using the TSTC
CMS or any other CMS used for website and portal.

Performs usability and accessibility testing utilizing different browsers and devices such as
mobile, tablet, and phone formats to ensure all users can access the website and portal
effectively.

Coordinates, designs web and portal pages with assistance from the designers to keep in
line with branding guidelines as needed to keep the sites fresh and up to date.

positions.title: Web Designer

positions.title: CMS Content Developer
positions.description:
As a developer, I support client by developing content for daily, monthly and quarterly projects. I also supports client CMS by developing content to meet documented content development standards, adhering to project timelines, and resolving content related defects.

•	Structures content and perform quality assurance of the content and corresponding CMS.  
•	Adheres to maintenance plans/timelines, project plans/timelines, support plan summaries and production requirements documents.  
•	Completes pre and post release quality assurance, ensuring final pages published reflect legally approved content.  
•	Supports ongoing development and modifications by testing and reporting content related defects. 
•	Ensures appropriate metadata is applied for content tracking purposes  
•	Creates and applies personalization rules (JavaScript) to ensure sites receive the correct content as defined in creative deliverables.  
•	Works collaboratively with Development groups to ensure content is structured for IT consumption.  
•	Maintains an understanding of the complexities of the client's digital strategy requirements and how CMS capabilities support that strategy.

positions.title: Content Management System Developer
positions.description: Adheres to maintenance plans/timelines, project plans/timelines, support plan summaries and production requirements documents. Completes pre and post release quality assurance, ensuring final pages published reflect legally approved content. Supports ongoing development and modifications by testing and reporting content related defects. Works collaboratively with Development groups to ensure content is structure for IT consumption. Maintains an understanding of the complexities of the client's digital strategy requirements and how CMS capabilities support that strategy.

positions.title: Social Medial Analyst | Webmaster | Photographer
positions.description:
As a Social Media Analyst, I am responsible for maintaining the content and oversees day-to-day management of Hinds County Sheriff's Office, and assure quality and filing integrity of web pages.  I am both responsible for both the development and maintenance of both the technical and creative aspects of the website. Coordinate the publishing of web site content, user interface, look and feel to suit a wide range of business needs. Responsible for working closely with business units and systems teams to coordinate content, developing ongoing site structure and updates. 

•	Professional Photography
•	Social Medias expert for the Hinds County Sheriff’s Office
•	Design billboards and flyers
•	User Interface / User Experience
•	Analyzed, designed, programmed, and installed computer systems and programs.
•	Engage and motivate online influencers
•	Increase community awareness of Hinds County
•	Help develop and be a key contributor to our social media strategies
•	Send out NIXLE alerts within the Metro Area. 
•	Monitor online and social conversations and actively participate in them to build brand visibility, thought leadership and solve consumer issues
•	Generate, edit, publish and share daily comments and content (original text, images, video or HTML) that builds meaningful connections.
•	Assist in production and writing Knowledge Base articles
•	Capture and analyze the appropriate social data/metrics, insights and best practices, and then acting on the information

positions.title: Application User Interface Designer
positions.description:
As an Application User Interface Designer, my responsibilities include the design, development and maintenance of front-end web applications. The incumbent will work closely with the user interface design and web development teams. Particular focus will be placed on user experience and search engine optimization to support the company’s strategic goals.

• Build Mobile Interfaces from an UI/UX prototypes.
• Sketch, wireframe, and prototype the user experience.
• Collaborate with project managers and developers to create the best possible solutions for the user.
• Translate business requirements into intuitive interactive solutions.
• Collaborate with visual designers and developers to create pixel perfect mockups and ensure designs are fully realized.
• Translate business requirements into intuitive interactive solutions

positions.title: Web Content Specialist
positions.description:
As a Web Content Specialist, I am responsible for creating, optimizing, and managing the delivery of online content for our clients.

•  Develop content strategies to drive sales of products and services through web sites, micro sites, online ads, e-mail marketing, and client presentations
•  Provide day-to-day management and legal approval of underlying deliverables
•  Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders such as business managers, designers, and developers to understand and translate business objectives into highly effective content
•  Monitor existing content, recommend optimizations, track the results, and evaluate effectiveness
•  Ensure consistency of content between multi-channel print and Web campaigns
•  Contribute to overall online strategy, marketing initiatives, and creative concepts

projects.description: McKinney “WorkHorse” Williams Jr. hails from the Westside of Jackson, MS, the Bottom to be exact.The two-time Jackson Music Award Nominee is one of the hottest underground artist to ever come out of Mississippi. He is also the only other hip-hop artist in the state of Mississippi to perform at the Jackson Music Awards besides David Banner. As a overlooked lyricist and underdog in the industry, he paves his own path with his unique brand of reality music. With music similar to Andre 3000 and B.O.B his musical ability is endless.
